about: Curated products of the catalog importer (docs/design/13-anvisa-catalog.md section 7): common Brazilian baby products that are missing or ambiguous in ANVISA's registered-medicines file. Imported with status 'curated' and source 'curated', shown as 'Curated list (not reviewed by a pharmacist)'. NOT reviewed by a pharmacist or pediatrician: every entry keeps reviewed=false until such a review, and must not be trusted before it. Each entry: id (stable key, lower-case letters, digits, dashes; never reuse or change it), name (display name; a name that ANVISA uses for a product with other ingredients must be made distinct, e.g. with 'Solução Nasal Salina'), form (drops, syrup, tablet, powder, spray, ointment, suppository, inhaler, other), ingredients (active-ingredient spellings of the curated substance map, pt-BR), reviewed, basis (where the composition comes from: a primary source or the owner's statement). Never add a dose, strength or indication. Never guess an ingredient from a name.

products.name: Flygas
products.basis: Owner statement (2026-10-21): Flygas is similar to simeticona, which is similar to Luftal. Not in ANVISA's registered-medicines file nor in the CMED price list (checked 2026-10-22).

products.name: Luftal
products.basis: CMED price list TA_PRECO_MEDICAMENTO.csv (2026-10-09): LUFTAL, presentation registration 1739000090031, substance SIMETICONA, emulsion with dropper. Its registration rows in DADOS_ABERTOS_MEDICAMENTOS.csv are all 'Inativo', so the official import leaves it out. Owner statement as for Flygas.

products.name: Colidis
products.basis: Manufacturer page https://www.ache.com.br/produto/suplementos-alimentares/colidis/ (checked 2026-10-22): a food supplement (not a registered medicine), active ingredient Limosilactobacillus reuteri DSM 17938, drops. It is not simethicone.

products.name: Sorine Solução Nasal Salina
products.basis: The saline Sorine products (e.g. Sorine SSC nasal spray) are notified low-risk products without registration or ingredient in the ANVISA file, while the registered 'Sorine' (1.0573.0050) is naphazoline, a decongestant. The inactive registration 1.0573.0352 'SORINE H' lists cloreto de sódio. Composition from retail listings and the coordinator, not a primary source: check the box.

products.name: Sorine Solução Nasal Salina
products.basis: As for the Sorine saline spray (coordinator request: spray and drops).

products.name: Rinosoro Solução Nasal Salina
products.basis: CMED price list (2026-10-09): RINOSORO SIC, presentation registration 1781700810141, nasal solution spray; its registration rows (cloreto de sódio) are 'Inativo' and the other Rinosoro products are notified without ingredient in the ANVISA file. Concentration varies by product: check the box.

products.name: Rinosoro Solução Nasal Salina
products.basis: Inactive ANVISA registrations of RINOSORO list cloreto de sódio; the active 'RINOSORO GOTAS' row is a notified product without ingredient. Coordinator request: spray and drops. Check the box.
